Subject: Executive sync + production demo window — Blue Horizon milestone

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. As discussed, we'd like to lock in two things this month so your team can validate the integration before the pilot kickoff: (1) a short executive alignment call (VP-level, 20–30 min) to confirm success metrics and escalation paths; and (2) a production-ready demo where your engineers and our SE run a full end-to-end flow with a sampled dataset.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Tue 2026-05-26 — 11:00–12:00 ET (demo slot; Q/A + test traffic)
- Thu 2026-05-28 — 10:00–10:30 ET (exec alignment)
- Mon 2026-06-01 — backup demo day, 11:00–12:00 ET

Can you confirm who from Blue Horizon will attend the exec sync (VP/C-level)? We want to reserve a brief pre-demo tech check with your engineers and our SE (Dev) 30 minutes before the demo.

I attached a very short MVP-demo-runbook that outlines the run order and the network/IPs we'll hit. If procurement needs any paperwork ahead of the demo, loop them in and we'll expedite.

Next steps: please confirm preferred exec slot and which demo window works best for your engineers. Once we land on a time I'll send a calendar invite and a lightweight mutual action plan (DocuSign link).

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: MVP-demo-runbook.pdf

Hi Marcus,

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from our side:
- Exec sponsor: Sanjay Rao (VP of Data & Product) — he'll be available for a 20–30 min sync but his calendar is tight.
- Engineering demo: myself + two platform engineers (Anita Kumar, Rajesh Iyer).
- Procurement: copied Tom (procurement lead) — we need a signed SOW/PO before any test traffic that hits production systems.
- Security: security@bluehorizon.ai is on the thread for the network checklist.

Preferred: Tue 2026-05-26 demo window works best for the engineering team, but Sanjay has a prep conflict on 5/26 and prefers something the week after. If possible can we tentatively put the exec sync on Thu 2026-05-28 at 10:00 ET and the demo on Mon 2026-06-01 11:00 ET? That gives Sanjay time to review.

I'll confirm internal approvals and loop in Tom for the PO timeline — Tom, can you confirm if we can get the PO by 2026-05-31?

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Platform | Blue Horizon Analytics

- Marcus to send calendar invites + DocuSign MAP link; Tom to confirm PO by 2026-05-31 if possible.
